reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No direct PD-1 occupancy data provided, but pembrolizumab is a well-established anti-PD-1 antibody with known target engagement at standard IV dosing. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No biomarker data provided to confirm T-cell activation or immune response modulation, which is a limitation in assessing mechanism validation. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Strong clinical efficacy demonstrated with HR 0.50 (95% CI 0.37-0.68, p=0.001) for PFS at 6 months in metastatic NSCLC, showing clear clinical benefit. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported, so cannot assess differential responses. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Adequate sample size (n=305), appropriate comparator (platinum-based chemotherapy), and reasonable duration (~1.6 years) suggest good trial design.
